title: Synthetic Commercial Loan Agreement (English - One-Sided)
summary_en: This legal document is a commercial loan and credit facility agreement established between Capital Growth Lending Services and a borrower on October 10, 2026. The core purpose is to extend a term loan of INR 1,500,000 for business expansion and capital equipment, while imposing strict repayment obligations, penalties, and guarantor liabilities. Based on the presence of five heavily restrictive clauses, the agreement carries an extremely high risk level for the borrower and guarantor due to provisions like retroactive penal interest, immediate loan acceleration without notice, mandatory prepayment penalties, unilateral rate adjustments, and direct personal asset seizure.
summary_hi: यह कानूनी दस्तावेज 10 अक्टूबर, 2026 को पूंजी विकास ऋण सेवाओं और एक उधारकर्ता के बीच स्थापित एक वाणिज्यिक ऋण और ऋण सुविधा समझौता है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य व्यापार विस्तार और पूंजी उपकरणों के लिए आई. एन. आर. 1,500,000 के सावधि ऋण का विस्तार करना है, साथ ही सख्त पुनर्भुगतान दायित्वों, शास्ति और गारंटर देनदारियों को लागू करना है। पांच भारी प्रतिबंधात्मक खंडों की उपस्थिति के आधार पर, समझौते में पूर्वव्यापी शास्ति संबंधी ब्याज, बिना सूचना के तत्काल ऋण त्वरण, अनिवार्य पूर्व भुगतान शास्ति, एकतरफा दर समायोजन और प्रत्यक्ष व्यक्तिगत संपत्ति जब्ती जैसे प्रावधानों के कारण उधारकर्ता और गारंटर के लिए एक अत्यधिक उच्च जोखिम स्तर है।
summary_ta: இந்த சட்ட ஆவணம் அக்டோபர் 10,2026 அன்று மூலதன வளர்ச்சி கடன் சேவைகள் மற்றும் ஒரு கடன் வாங்குபவருக்கு இடையே நிறுவப்பட்ட ஒரு வணிகக் கடன் மற்றும் கடன் வசதி ஒப்பந்தமாகும். வணிக விரிவாக்கம் மற்றும் மூலதன உபகரணங்களுக்கு ஐ. என். ஆர் 1,500,000 என்ற காலக் கடனை நீட்டிக்க வேண்டும், அதே நேரத்தில் கடுமையான திருப்பிச் செலுத்தும் கடமைகள், அபராதங்கள் மற்றும் உத்தரவாதக் கடன்களை விதிக்க வேண்டும். ஐந்து கடுமையான கட்டுப்பாட்டு பிரிவுகள் இருப்பதால், இந்த ஒப்பந்தம் கடன் வாங்குபவருக்கும் உத்தரவாதம் அளிப்பவருக்கும் மிகவும் அதிக ஆபத்து அளவைக் கொண்டுள்ளது, ஏனெனில் முந்தையகால தண்டனை வட்டி, அறிவிப்பு இல்லாமல் உடனடி கடன் முடுக்கம், கட்டாய முன்கூட்டிய செலுத்துதல் அபராதம், ஒருதலைப்பட்ச விகித மாற்றங்கள் மற்றும் நேரடி தனிப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களை பறிமுதல் செய்தல் போன்ற விதிமுறைகள் உள்ளன.

flagged_clauses.title: Acceleration of Loan
flagged_clauses.original_text:
Clause 3. Immediate Loan Acceleration Without Cure
Upon the occurrence of any technical breach or delay, the Lender shall have the unconditional right to declare all future
unmatured principal and interest immediately accelerated, due, and payable in full without providing any prior cure period,
formal demand, or legal notice.
flagged_clauses.explanation: The clause grants the lender the unconditional right to immediately accelerate all future principal and interest upon any technical breach or delay. This occurs without providing any prior cure period, formal demand, or legal notice.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason: This provision is heavily one-sided because it allows for immediate loan acceleration for minor or technical infractions without offering the borrower any opportunity to correct the issue. It exposes the borrower to severe financial risk and sudden default without warning.

flagged_clauses.title: Guarantor Liability
flagged_clauses.original_text:
Clause 6. Unlimited Continuing Guarantor Liability
The Guarantor undertakes an unlimited, irrevocable, and continuing personal guarantee for all present and future
obligations of the Borrower, authorizing the Lender to seize, attach, and liquidate the personal and family assets of the
Guarantor immediately upon default without first initiating recovery proceedings against the primary Borrower.
SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL CONTRACT
flagged_clauses.explanation: The clause establishes an unlimited, irrevocable, and continuing personal guarantee for all present and future obligations of the borrower. It permits the lender to immediately seize, attach, and liquidate the guarantor's personal and family assets upon default without first pursuing the primary borrower.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason: This clause is one-sided because it eliminates the requirement for the lender to exhaust recovery options against the primary borrower before targeting the guarantor's personal assets. It exposes the guarantor to immediate and unlimited financial liability without procedural protections.
flagged_clauses.explanation_hi: खंड उधारकर्ता के सभी वर्तमान और भविष्य के दायित्वों के लिए एक असीमित, अपरिवर्तनीय और निरंतर व्यक्तिगत गारंटी स्थापित करता है। यह ऋणदाता को पहले ऋणकर्ता का पीछा किए बिना चूक पर गारंटर की व्यक्तिगत और पारिवारिक संपत्तियों को तुरंत जब्त करने, कुर्क करने और परिसमापन करने की अनुमति देता है।

flagged_clauses.explanation_ta: இந்த பிரிவு கடன் வாங்குபவரின் தற்போதைய மற்றும் எதிர்கால கடமைகள் அனைத்திற்கும் வரம்பற்ற, மாற்ற முடியாத மற்றும் தொடர்ச்சியான தனிப்பட்ட உத்தரவாதத்தை நிறுவுகிறது. இது கடன் வழங்குபவரை முதலில் கடன் வாங்குபவரைப் பின்தொடராமல் உத்தரவாதம் அளிப்பவரின் தனிப்பட்ட மற்றும் குடும்ப சொத்துக்களை உடனடியாக பறிமுதல் செய்ய, இணைக்க மற்றும் கலைக்க அனுமதிக்கிறது.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason_ta: இந்த விதி ஒருதலைப்பட்சமானது, ஏனெனில் இது உத்தரவாதம் அளிப்பவரின் தனிப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களை குறிவைப்பதற்கு முன்பு கடன் வழங்குபவர் முதன்மை கடன் வாங்குபவருக்கு எதிரான மீட்பு விருப்பங்களை நிறுத்த வேண்டிய தேவையை நீக்குகிறது. இது உத்தரவாதம் அளிப்பவருக்கு நடைமுறை பாதுகாப்புகள் இல்லாமல் உடனடி மற்றும் வரம்பற்ற நிதி பொறுப்பை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

grounding_examples.text: The Guarantor agrees to an unlimited, continuing, and irrevocable guarantee covering all present, past, and future indebtedness of Borrower and all its affiliates forever.
Guarantor remains perpetually liable for any increased credit limits, new facilities, or extensions granted by Lender to Borrower without Guarantor knowledge or signature.
Lender may proceed directly against Guarantor personal home and assets immediately without making any demand or claim against Borrower.
Guarantor waives all legal rights under contract law, including right to notice of variance, right of subrogation, and right to require Lender to proceed against Borrower first.

flagged_clauses.title: Penal / Default Interest
flagged_clauses.original_text:
Clause 2. Compound Penal and Default Interest
If any scheduled installment or interest payment remains unpaid for more than twenty-four (24) hours following its due date,
a compound penal interest rate of 36% per annum shall be applied retroactively to the entire original principal facility sum
from the date of initial disbursement until complete settlement.
flagged_clauses.explanation: The clause imposes a compound penal interest rate of 36% per annum if any payment is delayed by more than 24 hours. Furthermore, this penalty applies retroactively to the entire original principal sum from the date of initial disbursement.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason: This provision is one-sided because a short 24-hour grace period triggers an extreme penal rate applied retroactively to the entire principal rather than just the overdue amount. This creates disproportionate financial exposure for a minor or brief payment delay.
flagged_clauses.explanation_hi: यह खंड प्रति वर्ष 36 प्रतिशत की चक्रवृद्धि शास्ति संबंधी ब्याज दर लागू करता है यदि किसी भी भुगतान में 24 घंटे से अधिक की देरी होती है। इसके अलावा, यह शास्ति प्रारंभिक संवितरण की तारीख से पूरी मूल मूल राशि पर पूर्वव्यापी रूप से लागू होता है।
flagged_clauses.risk_reason_hi: यह प्रावधान एकतरफा है क्योंकि एक छोटी 24 घंटे की छूट अवधि केवल बकाया राशि के बजाय पूरे मूलधन पर पूर्वव्यापी रूप से लागू एक अत्यधिक शास्ति दर को ट्रिगर करती है। यह एक मामूली या संक्षिप्त भुगतान देरी के लिए असमान वित्तीय जोखिम पैदा करता है।
flagged_clauses.explanation_ta: எந்தவொரு கொடுப்பனவும் 24 மணி நேரத்திற்கும் மேலாக தாமதமாக இருந்தால் இந்த பிரிவு ஆண்டுக்கு 36 சதவீதம் கூட்டு அபராத வட்டி விகிதத்தை விதிக்கிறது. மேலும், இந்த அபராதம் ஆரம்ப கொடுப்பனவு தேதியிலிருந்து முழு அசல் தொகைக்கும் முந்தைய காலத்திற்கு பொருந்தும்.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason_ta: இந்த விதி ஒருதலைப்பட்சமானது, ஏனெனில் ஒரு குறுகிய 24 மணி நேர சலுகைக் காலம், காலாவதியான தொகையை விட முழு அசல் தொகையிலும் முந்தைய காலத்தில் பயன்படுத்தப்படும் தீவிர தண்டனை விகிதத்தைத் தூண்டுகிறது. இது ஒரு சிறிய அல்லது குறுகிய கட்டண தாமதத்திற்கு விகிதாசாரமான நிதி வெளிப்பாட்டை உருவாக்குகிறது.

statutory_provisions.title: Compensation for breach of contract where penalty stipulated for
statutory_provisions.text: 74. Compensation for breach of contract where penalty stipulated for.—When a contract has been broken, if a sum is named in the contract as the amount to be paid in case of such breach, or if the contract contains any other stipulation by way of penalty, the party complaining of the breach is entitled, whether or not actual damage or loss is proved to have been caused thereby, to receive from the party who has broken the contract reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount so named or, as the case may be, the penalty stipulated for. Explanation.—A stipulation for increased interest from the date of default may be a stipulation by way of penalty. Exception.—When any person enters into any bail-bond, recognizance or other instrument of the same nature, or, under the provisions of any law, or under the orders of the Central Government or of any State Government, gives any bond for the performance of any public duty or act in which the public are interested, he shall be liable, upon breach of the condition of any such instrument, to pay the whole sum mentioned therein. Explanation.—A person who enters into a contract with Government does not necessarily thereby undertake any public duty, or promise to do an act in which the public are interested.

statutory_provisions.title: Compensation for breach of contract where penalty stipulated for
statutory_provisions.text: 74. Compensation for breach of contract where penalty stipulated for.—When a contract has been broken, if a sum is named in the contract as the amount to be paid in case of such breach, or if the contract contains any other stipulation by way of penalty, the party complaining of the breach is entitled, whether or not actual damage or loss is proved to have been caused thereby, to receive from the party who has broken the contract reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount so named or, as the case may be, the penalty stipulated for. Explanation.—A stipulation for increased interest from the date of default may be a stipulation by way of penalty. Exception.—When any person enters into any bail-bond, recognizance or other instrument of the same nature, or, under the provisions of any law, or under the orders of the Central Government or of any State Government, gives any bond for the performance of any public duty or act in which the public are interested, he shall be liable, upon breach of the condition of any such instrument, to pay the whole sum mentioned therein. Explanation.—A person who enters into a contract with Government does not necessarily thereby undertake any public duty, or promise to do an act in which the public are interested.

28.Agreements in restraint of legal proceedings, void.—Every agreement,— (a) by which any party thereto is restricted absolutely from enforcing his rights under or in respect of any contract, by the usual legal proceedings in the ordinary tribunals, or which limits the time within which he may thus enforce his rights; or (b) which extinguishes the rights of any party thereto, or discharges any party thereto, from any liability, under or in respect of any contract on the expiry of a specified period so as to restrict any party from enforcing his rights, is void to the extent. Exception 1.—Saving of contract to refer to arbitration dispute that may arise.—This section shall not render illegal a contract, by which two or more persons agree that any dispute which may arise between them in respect of any subject or class of subjects shall be referred to arbitration, and that only the amount awarded in such arbitration shall be recoverable in respect of the dispute so referred. Exception 2.—Saving of contract to refer questions that have already arisen.—Nor shall this section render illegal any contract in writing, by which two or more persons agree to refer to arbitration any question between them which has already arisen, or affect any provision of any law in force for the time being as to references to arbitration4. Exception 3.—Saving of a guarantee agreement of a bank or a financial institution.—This section shall not render illegal a contract in writing by which any bank or financial institution stipulate a term in a guarantee or any agreement making a provision for guarantee for extinguishment of the rights or discharge of any party thereto from any liability under or in respect of such guarantee or agreement on the expiry of a specified period which is not less than one year from the date of occurring or non-occurring of a specified event for extinguishment or discharge of such party from the said liability. Explanation.—(i) In Exception 3, the expression "bank" means— (a) a "banking company" as defined in clause (c) of section 5 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949(10 of 1949); (b) "a corresponding new bank" as defined in clause (da) of section 5 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949(10 of 1949); (c) "State Bank of India" constituted under section 3 of the State Bank of India Act, 1955 (23 of 1955); (d) "a subsidiary bank" as defined in clause (k) of section 2 of the State Bank of India (Subsidiary Banks) Act, 1959(38 of 1959); (e) "a Regional Rural Bank" established under section 3 of the Regional Rural Banks Act, 1976(21 of 1976); (f) "a Co-operative Bank" as defined in clause (cci) of section 5 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949(10 of 1949); (g) "a multi-State co-operative bank" as defined in clause (cciiia) of section 5 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949(10 of 1949); and (ii) In Exception 3, the expression "a financial institution" means any public financial institution within the meaning of section 4A of the Companies Act, 1956(1 of 1956).

statutory_provisions.title: Power to set aside contract induced by undue influence
statutory_provisions.text: 19A. Power to set aside contract induced by undue influence.—When consent to an agreement is caused by undue influence, the agreement is a contract voidable at the option of the party whose consent was so caused. Any such contract may be set aside either absolutely or, if the party who was entitled to avoid it has received any benefit thereunder, upon such terms and conditions as to the Court may seem just.

flagged_clauses.title: Unilateral Interest Rate Change
flagged_clauses.original_text:
Clause 5. Unilateral Interest Rate Adjustment
The Lender reserves the sole, unilateral, and unreviewable authority to increase or alter the interest rate at any time at its
discretion, without benchmark linkage or advance notification, and the Borrower waives all rights to contest or challenge any
revised repayment schedule.
flagged_clauses.explanation: The clause grants the lender sole authority to alter or increase the interest rate at any time without advance notice or benchmark linkage. Additionally, the borrower waives all rights to contest any resulting changes to the repayment schedule.
flagged_clauses.risk_reason: This provision is one-sided because it exposes the borrower to unpredictable financial obligations without providing any mechanism for notification, negotiation, or defense. The complete waiver of contest rights removes borrower protections against arbitrary rate increases.

standard_alternatives: Interest rates shall vary strictly in accordance with published changes in the Reserve Bank of India repo rate or external benchmark benchmarked transparently.
Any modification to the floating benchmark rate shall be notified to Borrower 30 days in advance with the option to prepay the loan without penalty if unaccepted.
The applicable interest rate shall be pegged to the standard Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) published quarterly by the banking regulator.
Changes to the margin spread shall require mutual written consent, while the benchmark rate shall adjust automatically to regulatory market movements.
